issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests were added for login, register, logout, password reset, or verification despite conventions requiring tests for every feature plus unauthorized-call and tamper tests for Livewire actions.
Livewire full-page components never attach the new Blade layout, so login/register render without layouts/app.blade.php.
Livewire inputs are validated with inline $this->validate([...]) instead of the project-mandated #[Validate] attributes plus $this->validate().

Throttle key uses str()->lower($this->email) which passes the email as an argument to a no-arg Stringable method, so the per-email part collapses and brute-force protection does not isolate attackers by email.
Register stores password as plain $this->password with User::create without Hash::make, relying on an unseen hashed cast that is not in the diff.
Existing views under resources/views were not converted to route() helpers since the diff touches no welcome or bulma-test view, leaving the every-view requirement unverified/missing.
issues.location: resources/views (only new files added; existing views untouched)

issues.explanation: Verification resend notice displays the raw status string verification-link-sent instead of a translated message, violating the never-hardcoded screen-text rule.
Reset-password store validates three fields inline with $request->validate instead of a Form Request as required once rules grow beyond one or two fields.
Custom EmailVerificationRequest re-implements Illuminate/Foundation/Auth/EmailVerificationRequest authorize logic instead of reusing the framework class.
Identical six-line session-regenerate fallback block is copy-pasted in Login and Register instead of a single request()->session()->regenerate() call.
Register hits the IP limiter on every submit and never clears it on success, so five legitimate registrations from one IP lock out further registrations.
No README, docs, PHPDoc, or CHANGELOG update accompanies the new auth flow despite the keep-docs-in-sync rule.
Unused Str import remains while the code uses the str() helper instead.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:268 uses $this->validate([...]) without #[Validate]; app/Http/Controllers/ResetPasswordController.php:179 validates 3 fields inline; no tests or docs updates in diff

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:293-301 convoluted session fallback; app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:5 unused Str import; app/Http/Controllers/ResetPasswordController.php:171 passes whole 'request' to view

requirements.evidence: layouts/app.blade.php created but Login.php:306-309 and Register.php:383-386 never call ->layout(); verify-email.blade.php:587 shows raw 'verification-link-sent'; existing views untouched for route() rule

scope.evidence: every hunk maps to task contract (routes, Livewire, controllers, views, lang, phpunit, .env.example); no unrelated refactors

security.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:273 str()->lower($this->email) breaks per-email key; app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:360-364 plain password without Hash::make; otherwise signed+throttle, remember_token rotation, and auth.failed/auth.throttle handling present

simplicity.evidence: app/Http/Requests/Auth/EmailVerificationRequest.php:20-30 duplicates framework request; app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:293-301 duplicated session block in Register

tests.evidence: change.diff contains zero new tests under tests/ and no tamper/unauthorized Livewire tests

review.summary: The change implements the full session auth flow with correct routes, throttling, localization, and verification logic, but ships no tests, skips the mandated #[Validate] pattern, never wires the new layout into the Livewire pages, and contains a broken login throttle key plus unhashed password creation.
